blocks.html: Manila, Philippines – September 2025 – For the second consecutive year, RLC Residences has been hailed Developer of the Year at the prestigious DOT Property Philippines Awards 2025, held at Okada Manila. This back-to-back recognition cements the company’s standing as one of the country’s trusted and innovative real estate developers.

Alongside this top honor, RLC Residences also garnered several other distinctions that highlight the strength and versatility of its portfolio. The company received the Special Recognition Award for Sustainable Construction, underscoring its commitment to responsible building practices. Premium development Le Pont Residences in Bridgetowne Destination Estate was celebrated for Best Condominium Architectural Design, while family-centric MIRA in Quezon City earned the title of Best Smart Home Condominium for its integration of future-ready living features.

blocks.cap: Le Pont Residences in Bridgetowne Destination Estate, Pasig City won the Best Condo Architectural Design award at Dot Property Philippines Awards 2025
Sustainability Spotlight: RLC Residences proudly receives the Special Recognition for Sustainable Construction at the Dot Property Philippines Awards 2025

blocks.html: On the other hand, Mantawi Residences in Cebu was named Best Sustainable Development as the first EDGE-certified residential development in the province, while SYNC along C5 Road, Pasig City was recognized as the Best Starter Home Condominium, affirming RLC Residences’ ability to cater to a wide range of homebuyer needs.

“These back-to-back recognitions as Developer of the Year affirm our purpose of building homes that go beyond four walls—they are spaces designed to nurture lifestyles, support ambitions, and provide lasting value to residents,” said Karen Cesario, Senior Director, Marketing Head and Chief Integration Officer of RLC Residences. “Backed by Robinsons Land’s 45 years of expertise in real estate, we are inspired to keep raising the bar in residential development, ensuring that every project we deliver is thoughtfully designed and built for the future.”

Innovation meets everyday living as MIRA wins Best Smart Home Development, celebrated for its seamless integration of smart features that make life more convenient and connected
Sustainability recognized. Mantawi Residences earns the Best Sustainable Development award, driven by its achievement as Cebu’s first EDGE-certified residential project

blocks.html: The DOT Property Philippines Awards, organized by DOT Property Group—one of Southeast Asia’s largest real estate marketplaces—celebrates the best developers and projects that define excellence, sustainability, and innovation in the industry. With a reputation for honoring the most outstanding property companies across the region, the award has become a trusted benchmark of quality and achievement.

These latest recognitions mark another milestone for RLC Residences, which also earned the distinction of Developer of the Year Southeast Asia at the DOT Property Asia Awards 2024. As the residential division of Robinsons Land, the company continues to deliver homes that reflect the evolving aspirations of Filipino families and global investors.
For more details about RLC Residences’ award-winning developments, visit rlcresidences.com or follow them on Facebook and Instagram.
